conclusion: With no barge-in handling the assistant kept talking for 4075 ms on average after the user spoke, streaming in 100 ms chunks with a 12 dB energy detector cut that to 155 ms (it reacted in 123 ms on the 20 of 20 speech runs it caught in time), and the 6 dB threshold reacted in 81 ms on the 20 of 20 speech runs it caught in time with 100% cough and 95% clatter false stops, while the 18 dB threshold reacted in 178 ms on the 20 of 20 speech runs it caught in time with 15% and 0%.
setup: simulated 16 kHz mic, 20 ms frames, 8000 ms reply, 100 ms playback chunks (a stop on a chunk boundary cancels before the next chunk starts), detection delay averaged over valid detections only, energy VAD firing after 3 frames above 6/12/18 dB over a noise floor calibrated on the first 500 ms, 20 runs per case (speech, cough, clatter), onset 1500 to 6500 ms, levels user 26±3 dB, cough 22±3 dB, clatter 10±3 dB, echo assumed cancelled, seed 15
